privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
Article 1 (General) LUA Corporation ("the Company") respects users' privacy and complies with the Personal Information Protection Act and related regulations.

Article 2 (Items and Method of Collection) The Company collects name, contact number, email, and the content of the inquiry in order to respond to inquiries. Collection is limited to email submissions.

Article 3 (Purpose of Use) Collected personal information is used solely to respond to and consult on inquiries.

Article 4 (Retention Period) Personal information is destroyed without delay once the purpose is achieved, except where retention is required by law.

Article 5 (Provision to Third Parties) The Company does not provide users' personal information to third parties, except as required by law.

Article 6 (Rights of Users) Users may request access, correction, deletion, or suspension of processing of their personal information at any time, and the Company shall act without delay.

Article 7 (Privacy Officer) Name: Ryu Jinwoo / Phone: ____ / Email: ____

Article 8 (Duty of Notice) Any change to this policy will be announced on the website at least 7 days before it takes effect. Effective date: __/__/____
